consequence.statement: With Helm 3.17.1, the null security context value in redis-ha subchart values.yaml would be rejected during chart validation, preventing successful chart deployment or upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to Argo CD 3.0.0 or later which removes the problematic null value, allowing Helm 3.17.1 to successfully validate and deploy the chart.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 removes a null security context value from the redis-ha Helm subchart values to resolve validation errors with Helm 3.17.1.
